test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "have told us."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The phrase** "have told us"** would be suitable in the blank as we want to emphasize the communication of information or guidance by these entities (family, friends, school, and society) through verbal means.
 
• It suggests that these influences have actively conveyed certain values, principles, or expectations through spoken words, advice, or explicit instructions.
 
• This construction implies that not only have they communicated verbally but have also demonstrated through their behavior or actions, providing a comprehensive understanding of the expected behavior or values.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

By the time__ we reach puberty, the world has reached us and __shaped__ us to a greater extent than we realize. __Our__ family, friends, school, and society in general __**have told us**__ by word and example how to be. But people ______ (5) ______ leaders at that moment when they decide for themselves how to be.
